question: How often does the registered CPU reader give the same story type as the engine's own rule on Clef's stored gate, over every stored engine story?
one_change: read the stored engine stories with the registered reader on title plus two sentences and compare with the engine type, scoring only

baseline.model: always answering the most common engine type, on a 300-story slice

prediction.why: a pilot on a random slice of 300 stories gave 0.42; the engine calls 55 percent of stories unclear and 41 percent fact while the reader says fact for 86 percent, so agreement is bounded by the unclear share; sampling error on 300 is about 0.06
